decisions.reason: As a newly launched product with its own dedicated page, it appears to be a meaningful option whose value is still being tested and is inexpensive for a software firm to keep open a bit longer.
Its standalone presentation suggests a deliberate commitment, and after only one year the firm is likely to preserve this option while demand uncertainty in a specialized tariff niche still resolves.
A dedicated page indicates stronger early commitment, and the low carrying cost of a digital calculator makes continued market presence reasonable despite uncertain traction.
